terms.title: Delivery of 100 widgets to Depot B on 2026-10-10
terms.claim: The supplier delivered 100 widgets to Depot B on 2026-10-10

criteria.text: 100 widgets were delivered to Depot B on 2026-10-10

leader_recorded: the finer label of a criterion that is not supported, and so of the overall finding

criteria.rationale: E-0002 is a photo showing boxes with visible text reading 'DEPOT B', 'ORDER 42', '100 WIDGETS', and 'DELIVERED 2026-10-10'. The photo itself shows the text but does not show when it was taken; the date is a declared label. E-0003 is a delivery note filed by the claimant stating 100 widgets were received at Depot B on 2026-10-10. E-0004 is a receipt confirmation filed by the respondent confirming receipt of 100 widgets at Depot B on 2026-10-10. Both documents are party statements/records. Together, the claimant's and respondent's documents corroborate the quantity, location, and date. The photo's text also aligns with the delivery details. No evidence contradicts the criterion.
criteria.text: 100 widgets were delivered to Depot B on 2026-10-10

limitations: The photo E-0002 does not independently establish when it was taken; the date is derived from visible text or filing claims.

observations.shows: A digital illustration showing a large stack of identical brown cardboard boxes arranged in neat rows on a brown pallet, set against a plain grey wall and grey floor. A white sign in the upper right corner displays delivery-related text. The boxes appear undamaged and uniformly stacked in a warehouse-style setting.

decision.scope: Whether the filed evidence establishes each criterion the parties accepted before the evidence was filed. Not a legal finding, not a finding about who is telling the truth, and not proof of when a photograph was taken or that a file is authentic.
